horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: Your ruler Mars is progressing in the fire sign Leo, so this is a week full of activity. Children will need more of your time, especially regarding studies, activities, travel, or something they have been waiting to do. Some of you will spend money on them as well. A personal project that you had pushed aside will come back into focus, and this time you will want to finish it properly. Your love life will be active, but not necessarily peaceful throughout the week. You will be quick to react when someone disappoints you, and a small issue will easily turn into an argument. There will be some entertainment events and social gatherings too.

One of the major event of this week will be the full moon in Libra, which will bring some completions in personal or professional relationships. Since the full moon indicates completions, you will signs some documents or you will get an information which you were waiting for. Married couples will have a serious discussion about the future, family responsibilities, money, or something that has been creating tension lately. At work, you will also deal with people more closely than usual. Clients will come back with questions, negotiations will continue, and one agreement will need another round of discussion before it is settled.

Venus retrogression through eighth house is a red flag, so you have to handle your money carefully. An old payment, insurance matter, tax issue, loan, reimbursement, or family expense will come up again. You will also wonder whether a recent financial decision was really worth it. Avoid rushing into another large purchase until you have checked what is already going out of your account. On the personal side, something from the past will bother you again, it can be ex, or financial deal. It will involve either an old relationship or an issue you thought was already settled.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Taurus Sun, Moon and rising signs there will be a lot of work regarding your home and family matters. Martian transit through the fire sign of Leo, so there will be some real estate deals and repair. Relocation, family functions and disagreements with family members also will be coming up. There are chances for vehicle repair or some travel plans with blocks. Martian transit will aspect the tenth house, so there will be some complex projects as well. Please avoid any kind of aggressive behaviour at work and home, otherwise you will complicate things. Listen to everyone carefully, and consider their advice.

The full moon will be rising in Libra, and this will highlight workplace relationships, so avoid unnecessary arguments at work. Work will become unusually busy around the middle of the week. The full moon indicates completions, so some delayed task will end this week. The full moon will rise in the sixth house, you will compete these tasks to start something new. If you have been waiting for an interview result, approval, document, or response from the office, you will hear something. Health will also demand attention. Your pet animals also will demand more attention, or someone will adopt new.

Venus is retrograding through the seventh house, so this is not a great week to start a new relationship. Couples have to be careful as some disagreements can happen for minor reasons. A former partner will also reappear in the lives of some Taurus natives, either through a message, phone call, meeting, or information received through someone else. Business partnerships will go through a similar review. A client or ex who disappeared earlier will return, while an existing agreement will require changes before everyone is satisfied. This will not be the best week to force quick decisions. What needs another conversation will get one.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: Gemini individuals, across Sun, Moon, and rising placements, can expect heightened activity in areas of communication, travel, and personal initiatives. The transit of Mars through the third house suggests a period marked by numerous discussions, meetings, phone calls, and short journeys. Significant matters involving siblings or neighbors may also arise. This phase will be particularly active for those engaged in teaching, writing, sales, publishing, and information technology sectors. While directness in communication is anticipated, there is a potential for words to be perceived more assertively than intended. Minor challenges related to electronic devices or vehicles could also emerge.

The Full Moon will rise in the fifth house, and this will bring some important developments regarding children, love life and creative projects. Parents will have more responsibilities regarding their children, and there will be an important event connected with their studies, examination, admission or other activities. Some children will complete a course or project. The full moon indicates completions, and the duration of the full moon will last for the next six months, so you can expect some completion in the projects also in the relationships. Singles will also meet someone interesting, especially through social gatherings or entertainment programs. Creative professionals will complete an important project or present their work. There will be some celebrations, parties or gatherings as well. Please avoid risky financial dealings and speculation this week.

Venus is retrograding through the sixth house, so workplace relationships will need more attention. Retrogression phase is like the universe is reminding you about old events, so you will find old colleagues, ex, or your old enemies. This period also will bring revisions, so make sure you cross check your work before final submission. Office politics will also become visible, so stay away from unnecessary discussions about co-workers. Health will need attention too, especially if you have been ignoring an old issue.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Cancer Sun, Moon and rising signs, financial matters and family discussions will become very important this week. Mars is moving through the second house, so there will be more expenses, especially for family needs, household matters, travel or other immediate requirements. At the same time, you will try to improve your income, and some of you will look for an additional source of earnings. Family discussions will become heated very quickly, so be careful with your words. There will be some important decisions regarding savings, investments or valuables as well. Please avoid lending money without proper clarity, and control unnecessary spending during this week.

The Full Moon will rise in the fourth house, so something important will happen regarding your home, family or property matters. The Full Moon indicates completion, therefore a relocation, renovation, repair or real estate matter that has been moving slowly will reach an important stage. Some of you will complete paperwork connected with a house, land or vehicle. There will be family gatherings, visitors or an important event at home as well. Your mother or another elderly woman in the family will need more attention. Those who have been planning to move will get more clarity.

Venus is retrograding through the fifth house, so matters connected with love, children and creative projects will go through a review. This is not a great week to rush into a new romantic relationship, especially when you still have doubts about the other person. An old lover or someone you were once emotionally attached to will contact some of you. Couples will bring up an old disagreement, but this time there will be a chance to understand what actually went wrong. Parents will reconsider some decisions regarding children’s education or activities. This is a very good time for check-ups for couples making multiple attempts for childbirth.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Leo Sun, Moon and rising signs, this will be an action-packed week as Mars is moving through your sign. You will be busy with your personal plans, work and many other responsibilities, and there will be very little time to sit idle. The urge to start a new project or a new relationship is strong, but this is at work, you will take the lead in an important project, but please do not try to control everything. Arguments will come up when others question your decisions. Since Mars is a very aggressive planet, so there are chances minor cuts and burns too.

The Full Moon will rise in the third house, so communication and travel will become very important. There will be many phone calls, meetings, emails and discussions, and one important matter will finally come to a conclusion. Some of you will finish a course, training, document, application or project which you started earlier. There will be a short trip as well, and this can come up with very little notice. Your siblings will have some important developments in their life, and they will need your support or advice. Those who work in writing, teaching, sales, media, marketing or social media will have a busy week.

Venus is moving through the fourth house, but it is slow, so there will be some complex developments at home. You will spend money on household items, furniture, decoration or anything that makes the house more comfortable, but this is not a favourable time for that. Discussions regarding renovation or relocation. Family members will come together for a function, celebration or some other happy occasion. Your mother will also have something important happening in her life. There will be more visitors at home, and some of you will invite friends over. Property discussions will move forward, but please check the financial side properly before making a final commitment.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Virgo Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the twelfth house, and expenses will be one of the main concerns this week. Money will go towards travel, health, repairs or something that you did not include in your monthly budget. Mars is moving through the twelfth house of expenses, there will be multiple expenses and you have to be prepared for that. At work, you will be handling certain things quietly, without getting much support or appreciation from others. Sleep will be affected if you continue carrying office problems to bed, so give yourself enough rest.

The Full Moon will rise in the second house, and there will be some movement in your financial matters. You will receive money that was due, clear a bill, close a payment or finally make a decision about an expense you have been postponing. Salary and income will also become a topic of discussion for some of you. There will be a lot happening within the family too. Money matters will be a bit complex from multiple angles, so you have to control the expenses. Watch your words, because you will say exactly what you think this week, and someone in the family will not take it lightly.

Venus is retrograding through the third house, so people from the past will start showing up again. It can be an old friend, former colleague, neighbour or even someone you once had feelings for. There will also be changes in short travel plans, and a trip that was cancelled earlier will come back for discussion. Writers, content creators, teachers, salespeople and media professionals will return to an old assignment and make changes before submitting it. Siblings will also need your attention. If there was an old misunderstanding between you, the same subject will come up again, giving both of you another chance to talk.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Libra Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the eleventh house, so you will be very active with your team, friends and professional groups. There will be new people coming into your circle, and some of these contacts will be useful for your career. Those who are looking for a job will get leads through friends or former colleagues, but disagreements with them also will come up. At work, you will have targets to meet, and you will push hard to get the expected results. Gains will come up, but expenses for friends like taking them to parties also will come up.

The Full Moon will rise in your sign, so naturally the focus will come back to you and your own life. The full moon indicates completions, so you will complete some personal matters in the next six months. If you were planning for makeover, you will do that in the next six months. Couples with marital issues will take crucial decisions during this phase. Relationships will feel this change because your partner will notice that you are approaching certain issues differently. This full moon will aspect the seventh house of business relationships and long trips too, so in the next six months, some major developments will happen in both areas.

Venus is retrograding through the second house, so money needs a proper review. An old payment will come back, or you will have to spend again on something you thought was already settled. Family finances will also become a topic of discussion, especially if there are shared expenses, property matters or purchases coming up. Some of you will receive money that was delayed earlier, but avoid treating it as extra spending money immediately. There are chances for family disagreements, so you have to be careful while handling them. Retrograde Venus in the second house can also bring some prank interview calls, so, you have to cross check the genuinely of such calls.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Scorpio Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the tenth house, so work will not allow you to relax much this week. The schedule will be tight, so at work you may go through pressure. There will be constant review, which can again keep you pressurised. Some of you will hear about a new position or additional responsibility within the company. Job seekers will have interviews and calls from recruiters. Business owners will also be busy finding new clients. Please be careful with senior colleagues, as you will not have much patience when someone questions your work.

The Full Moon will rise in the twelfth house, and there will be a lot happening away from public view. Some work that you have been doing quietly will finally come to an end. There will be travel plans too, especially long-distance or foreign travel, and those waiting for a visa or other documents will see some movement. Expenses will be slightly higher, and some of them will come without much warning. You will also need more rest because the hectic work schedule will affect your sleep. The twelfth house indicates isolated places, so there are chances for you to meet people in hospitals or isolation centres.

This is the time for people from the past to come back as Venus is retrograding through your sign, So, someone once liked will send a message, an ex will appear again, or you will unexpectedly hear something about a person who was once important to you. Whether you want to reopen that chapter is another question. Those already in a relationship will discuss something that happened earlier, especially an issue that was never completely settled. The desire to update your fashion and appearance will be intense, but this is not the right time for that.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: There will be a huge desire to break the barriers for every Sagittarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, as Mars is impacting the ninth house. This planet will bring sudden trips, and discussions with mentors. Students will have exams, applications, interviews or important discussions regarding their next course. Those working with foreign companies will have more communication with people from other countries. Mars being a negative planet, it will bring some arguments with your elders and mentors, so avoid such bad events. Otherwise there will be long term issues which can block your progress.

The Full Moon will rise in the eleventh house, and one of your recent efforts will start giving results. There will be some good news regarding income, a project, an application or something you have been waiting to hear about. At work, a team project will reach an important stage, and everyone will be looking at the final result. Friends will also be more present this week. There will be invitations, meetings, celebrations or a chance to reconnect with your wider circle. Some of you will receive help through a friend or professional contact.

Venus, the planet for love and diplomacy has started its retrogression through Scorpio, so your personal and private life will gain momentum, but in a darker shade. This Venus will bring people from the past for sure, but they will not stay longer. If you are already going through relationship issues, this Venus will fasten the breakup process. You can also expect medical expenses, but this will be for any chronic matters. Someone from the foreign lands can come up, or there will be some updates about your foreign settlement related plans. Keep financial matters under control, because small expenses will add up surprisingly fast.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Capricorn Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the eighth house, so money shared with others will need attention this week. There will be discussions about loans, taxes, insurance, inheritance, investments or your partner’s finances. An unexpected payment can disturb the budget, especially if you already have several expenses lined up. Some of you will be sorting out documents connected with a loan or insurance claim. Do not take financial decisions in a hurry just because somebody is putting pressure on you. At work too, there will be certain matters happening behind the scenes, and it will be better to know the full story before reacting to anything.

The Full Moon will rise in the tenth house, putting your career in the spotlight. An important project will reach completion, or you will finally know the outcome of something you have been working towards. There will be discussions with managers, and some Capricorns will hear about a promotion, new responsibility, transfer or change within the company. Those looking for a job will have an interview or receive an update regarding an earlier application. Your work will get noticed, but that also means mistakes will be noticed quickly. Business owners will have an important development regarding a client or contract. The Moon will aspect the home, also, you will complete some events at home.

Venus is retrograding through the eleventh house, and people from your old social or professional circle will start coming back. A former colleague, friend or business contact will suddenly message you, and some of these reconnections will actually be useful. You will also revisit your old business plans to resume it, but this is not the right time for that. Venus retrograde is not great for friendship, so this is not a great time to start a new long term venture or a friendship. Money expected through a project, commission or incentive can take longer to arrive, so do not depend on it for an immediate expense. An old wish or plan will also come back, and this time you will seriously consider trying it again.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Aquarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the seventh house, so dealing with people will take more energy than usual. Your spouse or partner will be quite demanding, and there will be arguments if both of you refuse to adjust. In some relationships, the real problem will be an issue that has been avoided for a while. This week it will come out openly. Business owners will have similar experiences with clients and partners. There will be negotiations, changes in agreements and a few difficult conversations. Singles will meet active and confident people, but relationships starting now will move very quickly. Give yourself enough time before making promises.

The Full Moon will rise in the ninth house, so there will be some important news regarding travel, studies or matters connected with another country. Those waiting for a visa, university admission, examination result or official approval will see movement. A long journey that has been discussed for weeks will finally get confirmed, and some of you will start booking tickets and accommodation. Students will complete an important part of their course or submit an assignment. There will also be discussions with teachers, mentors or senior people who will have a different opinion about your plans. Your father will need your attention as well. Please take care of your official documents.

Retrograde Venus will impact the tenth house, and this is not a great time to find a new job. You will start thinking about an old job, a company you worked for earlier or a career option you once rejected. Interestingly, someone from that period can contact you again. An old client can also return with fresh work. At your present workplace, a project you thought was finished will come back with corrections, and that can be slightly irritating. This Venus will aspect the fourth house so you will go to meet old friends, or they will come to meet you.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting October 11
content: For Pisces Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is moving through the sixth house, so work will be demanding, but you will also get a lot done. There will be deadlines, extra assignments and situations where you have to fix problems created by others. If there has been competition at work, you will be ready to prove what you can do. There will be some competitive events at work, it can come up as debates, brainstorming sessions, and interview calls. This is not a great time at work, and issues with co-workers will be coming up very often. Mars is moving through Leo, and it indicates sixth house of health, so your health also will be a bit sensitive.

The Full Moon will rise in the eighth house, bringing money shared with other people into focus. There will be a payment to settle, or you will finally get an answer regarding a loan, insurance claim, tax matter or another financial issue that has been hanging around. Couples will also have to sit down and discuss joint expenses. Some of you will discover that you are spending much more than expected on repayments or household commitments. Keep some money aside for an expense that comes without much warning. This week will also bring a private family matter into the open.

Your travel plans may get blocked as Venus is moving in a retrograde mode through the ninth house. A trip you planned earlier can come back, but the dates, budget or place of stay will change. Those waiting for visa-related matters will have to check the documents once again, and there will be some delay in getting things exactly as you want. Students will also rethink their higher studies, especially if the course is expensive or requires moving away from home. Some of you will contact an old teacher or mentor for guidance. There will also be a connection with people living far away. An old friend or someone you knew during college days can suddenly get in touch. If you are already travelling, avoid spending too much on shopping and entertainment. There can also be a family discussion regarding a long journey, education or relocation, and everyone will have a different opinion about what you should do.
